card.name: Small words in engine and generator text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, the, a, be, in) and number pieces in passages about engines, motors, generators and electrical machinery, where the next word is likely to be something other than 'power'.

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'power' in many forms, so it steers away from 'power' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small filler words in engine and generator descriptions and holds back the word 'power' from coming next.
